title: A Strongly Regular Graph Derivation of Standard Model Parameters: The W(3,3) Geometric Framework
description:
The W(3,3) theory derives all fundamental constants, particle quantum numbers, and mixing parameters of the Standard Model from the spectral data of the W(3,3) strongly regular graph SRG(40,12,2,4). From the three eigenvalues {12, 2, -4} with multiplicities {1, 27, 12} we recover:

  • Fine-structure constant α−1 = 137 (experiment: 137.036, error 0.026%)
  • Weinberg angle sin²θW = 3/13 ≈ 0.2308 at the Z-pole (error 0.18%)
  • SM gauge group U(1) × SU(2) × SU(3) from the spectral triple automorphism
  • Master energy scale E = 480 = |Φ(E8)| linking graph spectrum to the E8 root system
  • Neutrino mass sum Σmν = 30.7 meV (normal hierarchy, Majorana)
  • Atmospheric mixing angle θ23 = 45° (maximal mixing)
  • CP phase δCP = 80.1°
  • Eight falsifiable experimental predictions testable at JUNO, KATRIN, DUNE, Hyper-Kamiokande, LEGEND-1000, and LISA

The uniqueness of SRG(40,12,2,4) up to isomorphism eliminates all tunable moduli. This repository contains the full LaTeX paper, PRL letter, Python computation scripts, SVG figures, and arXiv submission bundle.
